label: AppImageLauncher
description: AppImageLauncher — integrates AppImages with the system. Installs the system RPM and provides user integration.
hint: System-level service (installs system RPM); this plugin has no GUI.

status.command: bash -lc 'command -v appimagelauncher >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; ls /usr/bin/*appimagelauncher* >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; ls /usr/local/bin/*appimagelauncher* >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; rpm -qa | grep -i -E "appim.*launch|appimage.*launch|appimagelauncher" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; ls /usr/share/applications/*appimagelauncher*.desktop >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; exit 1'
